name: Deterministic Browser Game Engine and Game

mentions.name: Deterministic Browser Game Engine and Game
mentions.description: A hand-crafted browser game engine and a game built for the engine, with determinism as a core design principle and several novel ideas; it uses AI minimally, has been in development for about six years, and is launching soon.
mentions.source_excerpt: A hand-crafted browser game-engine and game for the engine, with things like determinism at the core. I will be launching soon and can't talk too much about it yet because its quite novel.
